scope: Four rebuilt12-second review candidates; evidence-qualified57-item look-back, not full-film certification

items.requirement: Build around a bizarre scientific “what if” with understandable stakes.
items.verification: Review actual encoded opening and complete narrative alongside sourced claims; cite timecodes and what the viewer learns.
items.evidence: Four previously selected mechanism tests; no counterfactual Sun-style premise commissioned.

items.requirement: Open with a compelling mystery or contradiction rather than a textbook definition.
items.verification: Review actual encoded opening and complete narrative alongside sourced claims; cite timecodes and what the viewer learns.
items.evidence: Concrete repair, neighboring days, water-pump claw and underwater lake establish specific contradictions at0–1.6s.

items.requirement: Make the opening image and narration immediately reinforce each other.
items.verification: Review actual encoded opening and complete narrative alongside sourced claims; cite timecodes and what the viewer learns.
items.evidence: Encoded opening states show the named material/specimen or NOAA lake; the delayed Diomede/shrimp/brine voice begins1.8s. Intro delay is deliberate12-second-test staging, not an internal speech hole.

items.requirement: Deliver useful information early, then deepen the question.
items.verification: Review actual encoded opening and complete narrative alongside sourced claims; cite timecodes and what the viewer learns.
items.evidence: Mechanisms develop through the state times in CASE_CONTRACTS.json; useful relationship shown in first3.3s.

items.requirement: Develop an escalating chain of consequences instead of listing disconnected facts.
items.verification: Review actual encoded opening and complete narrative alongside sourced claims; cite timecodes and what the viewer learns.
items.evidence: Each test has a short causal chain; no full-episode escalation is claimed.

items.requirement: Use visual metaphors, comparisons and changes of scale to explain difficult concepts.
items.verification: Review actual encoded opening and complete narrative alongside sourced claims; cite timecodes and what the viewer learns.
items.evidence: Concrete inspection scale, linked map/date crossing, articulated claw macro, and equal-volume density comparison.

items.requirement: Resolve the opening question with a satisfying payoff.
items.verification: Review actual encoded opening and complete narrative alongside sourced claims; cite timecodes and what the viewer learns.
items.evidence: Resolved state at8.6–10.5s completes each short mechanism before endcard.

items.requirement: Clearly distinguish the impossible premise, established science and uncertain extrapolation.
items.verification: Review actual encoded opening and complete narrative alongside sourced claims; cite timecodes and what the viewer learns.
items.evidence: Source photograph credits and persistent illustrative/model labels distinguish conceptual art from observed evidence. See sources/limits in contracts.

items.requirement: Introduce a meaningful visible change every 1.5–2 seconds throughout the explanatory sequence.
items.verification: Inspect moving encoded compositions and joins at normal speed and phone size; record actual operation intervals, independent layer/camera changes, readable holds and exits.
items.evidence: Contracts log actual operation times. Deliberate final mechanism/tail reading hold9.4–10.9s, followed by locked ending. Holds within mechanisms include3.3–5.05s claw-part identification and3.5–5.4s equal-volume comparison. Concrete4.2–6.7s is a2.5s continuous calcium-release/read interval before deposition begins; this is an explicit test-specific hold, not a new cadence default.

items.requirement: Include substantial object animation—not merely photographs entering and then sitting still.
items.verification: Inspect moving encoded compositions and joins at normal speed and phone size; record actual operation intervals, independent layer/camera changes, readable holds and exits.
items.evidence: Actual gap filling/growth, traveler crossing/date change, hinged finger/jet/cavity collapse, tipping scale and independent terrain pool.

items.requirement: Use movement within compositions: separation, assembly, replacement, transformation, tracking and progressive reveals.
items.verification: Inspect moving encoded compositions and joins at normal speed and phone size; record actual operation intervals, independent layer/camera changes, readable holds and exits.
items.evidence: Separation, tracking, transformed source-coordinate annotations and progressive fluid/mineral reveals visible in dense encoded states.

items.requirement: Use purposeful camera pans, close-ups, pullbacks and changes of viewpoint.
items.verification: Inspect moving encoded compositions and joins at normal speed and phone size; record actual operation intervals, independent layer/camera changes, readable holds and exits.
items.evidence: Concrete and claw inspection, map rotation/enlargement, terrain reframing lead into specific relationships.

items.requirement: Build obvious parallax through independently moving foreground, subject and background layers.
items.verification: Inspect moving encoded compositions and joins at normal speed and phone size; record actual operation intervals, independent layer/camera changes, readable holds and exits.
items.evidence: Source parts act independently, but obvious foreground/subject/background camera parallax is not demonstrated consistently across all four. Do not claim full Sun craft parity.

items.requirement: Fully remove departing elements; prevent accidental overlaps and clipped labels.

Initial v2 Diomede/Brine label overlaps were found in encoded inspection and corrected in separately archived v2b; INITIAL_ENCODED_FINDINGS.json preserves the failures.

items.requirement: Evaluate scene and camera animation at 12 distinct states per second.
